title: Radical retrosynthesis: a powerful strategy for modern assembly of terpenoid natural products
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,10427-10486
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00760G, Review Article
Yong Zhang, Yanbo Zhang, Chao Li
This review highlights how radical retrosynthesis, leveraging modern methods developed in recent years, enables strategic bond disconnection in the synthesis of complex terpenoid natural products.
